resources.string: For MegaFon and Yota during mobile internet restrictions. Connects through Moscow to Europe. Availability depends on your mobile network.
Available through another account signed in on this device.
Attach a screenshot or photo of your MegaFon or Yota account page. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
Access works for all accounts on this device while at least one approved account remains signed in. No additional request is needed.

Your screenshot and its date, if present in the file, are sent to a moderator. Metadata does not prove authenticity. The screenshot is deleted after review or after the request expires in 24 hours; failed deletions are retried. Initial account verification requires a Telegram connection. One approved account signed in on this device is enough; signing out ends access unless another approved account remains.
Request expired. Submit a new one.
Attach a screenshot or photo of your mobile operator account page for review.
Screenshot must be no larger than 8 MB
Connect to Telegram to verify your account
